text: Ollama generation can return punctuation entries in sentence tokens; tune the enrichment prompt or add deterministic post-processing so new Rust output keeps tokens word-only and validates on first pass.
sentences generate shows no progress while waiting on a local Ollama request; add timing/progress output around model readiness, prompt send, response received, validation, and write/report steps.

sentences plan reports all legacy Python output as missing lineage, so the first Rust generation will duplicate existing cards; add clearer CLI wording or a migration/ignore strategy before large real runs.
Validation failures are stored and printed as one large multi-line error string; make run reports structure errors by sentence/index/field so failed model batches are easier to inspect.
